title: SSO/SAML IdP interoperability reconciler and validator test-harness for Okta/Azure/Google/Ping
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a reproducible interoperability reconciler and automated validator harness that codifies IdP-specific SAML quirks for Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, and Ping. This ticket covers: (A) a canonical attribute reconciliation layer for RBAC v2 mapping rules, (B) a validator that runs assertion surface checks and audit-log propagation tests, and (C) a staged rollout plan with telemetry and fallback policies. Goal: reduce manual support triage for SSO failures, prevent RBAC misassignments during rollouts, and provide deterministic audit trails for compliance audits.
acceptance_criteria: Reconciler library accepts IdP assertion inputs and outputs normalized attributes: email, external_id, group_paths, role_hint, and session_expiry

Validator harness runs against 4 IdP adapters (Okta/Azure/Google/Ping) and produces pass/fail + diagnostics for 95% of common edge cases (clock skew, name-formatting, multi-valued attributes, nested groups)
Audit-log tests assert that mapping decisions are logged with request_id, resolved_attributes, mapping_rule_id, outcome, and fallback_reason when applicable
No regressions in existing SSO e2e tests; CI includes the new validator and must pass on green
Rollout plan documented with canary percentages, feature flag toggles, and auto-rollback triggers based on error rate and customer-impact metrics
implementation_steps: Survey existing adapter failures from last 12 months and extract top-20 failure signatures (link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/sso-failures-summary)
Design attribute reconciliation schema and mapping DSL for RBAC v2 (design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/rbac-v2-attribute-reconciler)
Implement reconciler as a small Go library with pluggable IdP adapters; add unit tests for each normalization rule
Create validator harness that spins a lightweight test IdP simulator and replays recorded SAML assertions (store: gs://redwood-sso-test-artifacts/recordings)
Instrument audit-logging hooks: ensure mapping decisions emit structured events to audit topic with stable schema v1
Add CI pipeline job that runs validator across matrix of adapters and selected assertion recordings
Pilot with 3 internal orgs (engineering-qa, solutions-sandbox, sales-dev) behind a feature flag, collect metrics for 2 weeks
After pilot, update docs (admin runbook + troubleshooting) and schedule the production rollout with SRE and Support on-call
test_plan: Unit tests: mapping DSL edge cases (multi-value, missing email, scoped group prefixes)
Integration: adapter -> reconciler -> RBAC engine with synthetic user sessions; assert final roles match expectation
Validator harness scenarios: clock skew +/- 5m, duplicate NameID, nested group membership, SAML attribute aliasing (e.g., memberOf vs groups)
Audit log verification: replay assertion and assert corresponding JSON audit event appears in 'audit-sso-mappings' topic with expected fields
Load check: validator runs 1000 assertions within 10 minutes to validate throughput of reconciler component
Canary metrics: auth_error_rate, mapping_mismatch_rate, support_ticket_rate (per org) — auto-rollback if any > 3x baseline over 15m
